data.code:
import json
def main(selected_clips, theme):
    edit_result = {
        "theme": theme,
        "clips": selected_clips,
        "total_duration": sum(c.get("end",0)-c.get("start",0) for c in selected_clips),
        "added_music": True,
        "added_subtitles": True,
        "output_path": "/output/mixed_video.mp4",
        "status": "completed"
    }
    return edit_result
